notes.title: Back online!
notes.notes:
It was brought to our attention that players were unable to host an online game for the past day or so. We checked things out, and sure enough, our server backend was configured incorrectly. Oops! 

We just want to let everyone know that our server is back online, and you should once again be able to host a game.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for being patient with us!

notes.title: One week left for the Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I hope everyone is enjoying Bob Was Hungry so far! We are getting a lot of positive reviews, and for that, we are very grateful.

This is a reminder that the 33% launch discount ends on September 2nd! That's one week from now! Make sure to grab the game now at the discounted price of $9.99!

Keep posting those let's plays, and keep streaming on twitch! We are watching and loving everything!

Thank you very much!
-Keith
